<p class="page-lede">The lobbying organizations of the session. Click a firm for its positions filed and money spent.</p>

```{r}
library(gt)
source("scripts/shared.R")

lobbys <- read.csv(LOBBY_CSV) |>
  mutate(link = sprintf("[%s](%s/%s.html)", Lobby, LOBBY_PAGES_DIR, toupper(Code)))

lobbys |>
  select(link, Spending.Power) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    link = "Lobby",
    Spending.Power = "Spending Power"
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = link) |>
  opt_interactive(
    use_sorting = TRUE,
    use_filters = FALSE,
    use_resizers = TRUE,
    page_size_default = 20
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```
